entries.title: Isaiah 16:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Moab is exhorted to yield obedience to the throne of David. 6 Moab is threatened for her pride. 9 The prophet bewails her. 12 The judgment of Moab.

the lamb. 2Sa 8:2; 2Ki 3:4; Ezr 7:17 from. 2Ki 14:7 Sela. or, Petra. Heb. a rock. the mount. 10:32; Mic 4:8

entries.title: Isaiah 16:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: as. 13:14; Pr 27:8 cast out of the nest. or, a nest forsaken. the fords. Nu 21:13-15; De 2:36; 3:8,12; Jos 13:16; Jud 11:18

entries.title: Isaiah 16:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: mine. De 23:15,16; 24:14; Jer 21:12 for. 14:4; 33:1; 51:13; Jer 48:8,18; Zec 9:8 extortioner. Heb. wringer. oppressors. Heb. treaders down. 15:6; 25:10; Zec 10:5; Mal 4:3; Lu 21:24; Ro 16:20; Re 11:2

entries.title: Isaiah 16:7
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: shall Moab. 15:2-5; Jer 48:20 Kir-hareseth. 11; 15:1; 2Ki 3:25 mourn. or, mutter. 8:19

entries.title: Isaiah 16:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the fields. 15:4; 24:7; 2Sa 1:21 the vine. 9; Nu 32:38 Shibmah. Jos 13:19 the lords. 10:7; Jer 27:6,7 Jazer. Nu 32:3; Jos 13:25 stretched out. or, plucked up.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: I will bewail. 15:5; Jer 48:32-34 O Heshbon. 15:4 for. 9:3; Jud 9:27; Jer 40:10,12 the shouting for. or, the alarm is fallen upon, etc.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: three. 7:16; 15:5; 21:16; De 15:8 the glory. 17:4; 23:9; Ge 31:1; Es 5:11; Jer 9:23; Na 2:9,10 and the remnant. Jer 48:46,47 feeble. or, not many.
